description: Resolve anything a scanner or a person can produce — a chip UID, a GS1 Digital Link URI, or a GTIN plus serial — to a unit, and return its history and verdicts. This is the tool for "what is this thing in front of me". An identifier that resolves to nothing is NOT the same as one that fails verification: the first means we have never seen it, the second means we have and it did not check out. Report them differently.

uid.description: Chip UID read from a tap.

upi.description: Unique product identifier — usually a GS1 Digital Link URL.

name: find_unit
title: Find a unit
